tracking_boundary: decode + shared measured-motion session + actual adaptive FP + CUDA sync; session evidence included, final output serialization excluded; current-frame continuity decision and publication evidence included
initialization_boundary: mesh/frame loading + first-frame mask/click + FP setup + complete candidate registration/assessment + current-input GFTT and tentative measured session startup + evidence serialization; no trusted-memory initialization + continuity decision and publication evidence
parent_and_child_scope: Actual fresh process, all model loading and instrumentation included; parent also includes supervision and coverage checks. Throughput is not deployment inference FPS.
